### Added
- **`modelServing.gpuPool`: the GPU node pool's taint as a toleration and its label as a node selector on everything the serving layer schedules onto the pool, published for model-manager; the model-manager line moves to `>=0.23.0`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#315; bumblebee-plans#46, the plan's D3/D5; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). A GPU node pool created through the platform (the `gpu-node-pool` chart) arrives tainted `nvidia.com/gpu` `NoSchedule` and labelled `giantswarm.io/machine-pool=<cluster>-<pool>`; the serving layer tolerated no taint, so the vLLM runtime and every preset's predictor would land nowhere on such a pool. New: `modelServing.gpuPool.taint` (`key`, `value`, `effect`; the default is the pool chart's taint — `nvidia.com/gpu` `NoSchedule` with no value, tolerated with `operator: Exists`, so a pool whose taint carries a value is covered too; a `value` narrows it to `Equal`; an empty `key` is an untainted pool and renders nothing) and `modelServing.gpuPool.nodeSelector` (the pool's label, per pool and empty by default — the serving slice's values set it). The connectivity chart applies both to the `ClusterServingRuntime` (KServe copies them onto every predictor pod of the runtime; `runtime.tolerations` come after, `runtime.nodeSelector` keys win) and to every published preset's `scheduling` block (the pool's toleration first, the preset's own after it, an equal entry once; the pool's selector under the preset's own keys) through one helper (`agent-platform.modelServing.poolScheduling`), and publishes them in the discovery ConfigMap as `spec.gpuPool.taint.{key,value,effect}` and `spec.gpuPool.nodeSelector` — the keys model-manager 0.23.0 reads (giantswarm/model-manager#86) to schedule the `LLMInferenceService`s it composes, its download Jobs and its inventory scan pods by the same input (a registered backend document may override it). Platform components never carry it. Three render guards: the effect is one of the three taint effects, the key a qualified name, every selector value a string. `components.model-manager.versionRange` moves to `>=0.23.0 <1.0.0` (the floor: the release that reads the keys) and the example BOM pins `0.23.0`. `make verify-gpu-pool` (`tests/verify-gpu-pool.py`, fixture `ci/test-model-serving-gpu-pool-values.yaml`) asserts the three sites in the default, pool-selected, valued and untainted shapes, the guards, the meta chart's forwarding, and that an empty taint key leaves the serving render byte-identical to `origin/main` but for the discovery block. The default render is unchanged (model serving is off by default). **Every installation with model serving on rolls its predictors once** (the runtime gains the toleration and KServe reconciles every InferenceService of it; the models reload from the cache) **and model-manager once** (0.23.0). README of the connectivity chart, "The GPU node pool".
